title: Validate actual XNU sysroot, SDK and donor build-tool requirements
acceptance: Distinguish selected iOS16.5 runtime/XNU profile, official Xcode SDK version and a custom Theos sysroot label using pinned build scripts and official Apple release data
Trace exact embedded-compatible build tools, headers/linker/MIG/dependency/exports and host requirements rather than assuming a numeric SDK equality is sufficient or necessary
Identify which inputs are actually available, unavailable or independently buildable from pinned open source; no Apple binaries or upstream setup execution
Integrate corrected explicit input checks/next build steps while preserving KRN-001 owner reservations and historical evidence; source presence alone cannot qualify a full kernel build
steps: Review exact donor and embedded-era tool scripts as data
Compare official SDK/runtime matrix and actual script/header assumptions
Publish an input manifest and concrete build path or precise external gaps
